items.title: CISA, FBI and Partners Warn Organizations of SafePay Ransomware Actors Targeting Multiple Critical Infrastructure Sectors
CVE-2026-103406: exploited vulnerability in Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
items.note: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

items.title: CVE-2026-133469: exploited vulnerability in Vates Xen Orchestra
items.note: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

items.title: CVE-2025-41450: exploited vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
items.note: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

items.title: CVE-2023-25914: exploited vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
items.note: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

items.title: CVE-2023-25915: exploited vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series
items.note: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

items.title: CVE-2026-133324: exploited vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab
items.note: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

items.title: CVE-2026-133275: exploited vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab
items.note: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

items.title: CVE-2026-133311: exploited vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab
items.note: Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133303: exploited vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab
items.note: Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

items.title: CVE-2026-133323: exploited vulnerability in Mitel MiCollab
items.note: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

items.title: CVE-2026-132224: exploited vulnerability in Optimizely Web Experimentation
items.note: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

items.title: CVE-2026-131914: exploited vulnerability in Idunno AntiCsrf
items.note: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.title: CVE-2026-132165: exploited vulnerability in Drupal Core
items.note: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

items.title: CVE-2026-133968: exploited vulnerability in Project MONAI MONAI Label
items.note: Project MONAI MONAI Label contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to write arbitrary files outside the intended datastore directory, potentially resulting in remote code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-134624: exploited vulnerability in N-able MailAssure
items.note: N-able MailAssure (SpamExperts) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the LDAP synchronization connection check that allows an authenticated API user to connect to arbitrary internal hosts and ports, determine which are reachable, and send crafted data to internal services.

items.title: CVE-2024-3094: recently changed critical CVE
items.note:
Malicious code was discovered in the upstream tarballs of xz, starting with version 5.6.0. 
Through a series of complex obfuscations, the liblzma build process extracts a prebuilt object file from a disguised test file existing in the source code, which is then used to modify specific functions in the liblzma code. This results in a modified liblzma library that can be used by any software linked against this library, intercepting and modifying the data interaction with this library.

items.title: CVE-2025-10492: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A Java deserialisation vulnerability has been discovered in Jaspersoft Library. Improper handling of externally supplied data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely on systems that use the affected library

items.title: CVE-2025-34267: recently changed critical CVE

items.title: CVE-2025-14087: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A flaw was found in GLib (Gnome Lib). This vulnerability allows a remote attacker to cause heap corruption, leading to a denial of service or potential code execution via a buffer-underflow in the GVariant parser when processing maliciously crafted input strings.

items.title: CVE-2025-12543: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A flaw was found in the Undertow HTTP server core, which is used in WildFly, JBoss EAP, and other Java applications. The Undertow library fails to properly validate the Host header in incoming HTTP requests.As a result, requests containing malformed or malicious Host headers are processed without rejection, enabling attackers to poison caches, perform internal network scans, or hijack user sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-1775: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: The Labkotec LID-3300IP has an existing vulnerability in the ice detector software that enables an unauthenticated attacker to alter device parameters and run operational commands when specially crafted packets are sent to the device.

items.note:

items.note:

items.title: CVE-2026-2369: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A flaw was found in libsoup. An integer underflow vulnerability occurs when processing content with a zero-length resource, leading to a buffer overread. This can allow an attacker to potentially access sensitive information or cause an application level denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-28367: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A flaw was found in Undertow. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending `\r\r\r` as a header block terminator. This can be used for request smuggling with certain proxy servers, such as older versions of Apache Traffic Server and Google Cloud Classic Application Load Balancer, potentially leading to unauthorized access or manipulation of web requests.

items.title: CVE-2026-28368: recently changed critical CVE
items.note: A flaw was found in Undertow. This vulnerability allows a remote attacker to construct specially crafted requests where header names are parsed differently by Undertow compared to upstream proxies. This discrepancy in header interpretation can be exploited to launch request smuggling attacks, potentially bypassing security controls and accessing unauthorized resources.

items.title: Bromcom
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In September 2026, UK education software provider Bromcom suffered a data breach involving a legacy single sign-on (SSO) registration system. The incident exposed 355k unique email addresses belonging to staff and pupils at UK schools, alongside SSO registration reference numbers.

items.title: Too Lost
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In November 2026, an unauthorised party claimed to have obtained data from the music distributor for independent artists, Too Lost. The data contained 724k unique email addresses belonging to artists, their collaborators and fans. Some records also contained bcrypt password hashes, while a small subset included partial credit card data (last 4 digits and card type), identity verification information (in some cases, passport, driver's licence or national ID numbers), and payouts made to artists.

items.title: Careers360
items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog
items.note: In November 2026, data allegedly taken from the Indian education and careers platform Careers360 appeared on a public hacking forum. The 22M records included 3.6M unique email addresses alongside names, phone numbers, genders and caste categories, and most also contained students' entrance exam results, including ranks and marks.

items.source: Have I Been Pwned breach catalog

items.title: Gîtes de France

items.title: Data broker privacy watch
items.note: Recheck broker opt-out results every 30-90 days; many brokers repopulate data. Keep broker name, profile URL, date requested, and confirmation emails.

items.title: Unwanted software / bloatware watch
items.note: Watch for software that changes browser settings, injects ads, bundles unwanted offers, hides removal paths, exaggerates cleanup claims, or uses misleading install prompts.

items.title: Remote-access scam reminder
items.source: WireShield guidance from FTC/CISA-style scam prevention
items.note: Treat unexpected requests to install AnyDesk, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, RustDesk, or ScreenConnect as high risk, especially when paired with refunds, bank warnings, crypto, or gift cards.
